thesis: GO reported earnings after a run to the 52-week high and is indicated about 7% lower pre-market (12.98 vs 14.02 close), with the cause unknown because the news feed was down. Fundamentals are weak: revenue is flat (+0.9% YoY, down sequentially), the balance sheet is highly levered with little cash and negative FCF, and the mean analyst target (11.08) sits below even the gapped price. The 10-Q re-filed several prior-period results on the same day, which could mean a restatement and is unverified. The regime is risk-off with QQQ below its 50- and 200-day averages, so a small-cap, low-quality grocer that just spiked 38% in 63 days has little cushion. The technical card's own entry (13.30-13.75) is above the pre-market price, so the setup is already broken or unconfirmed, and buying a gap-down on unseen news is catching a falling knife.
